notes.title: Anointing the sick and confessing sins
notes.intro: James tells the sick to call the elders to pray and anoint them, and believers to confess sins to one another.

views.label: The sacraments of Anointing and Confession
views.summary: Catholic and Orthodox Christians see here the sacrament of Anointing of the Sick, and a basis for confession.

views.label: Prayer for healing today
views.summary: Pentecostals and charismatics practise anointing with oil and prayer for healing as a regular ministry.
views.source: Assemblies of God, Statement of Fundamental Truths, 12

views.label: Pastoral prayer and mutual confession
views.summary: Many Protestants practise prayer and anointing as pastoral care, and mutual confession among believers, not as sacraments.
